item.title: Dr. Umar May Have A Serious Legal Issue
item.description: A filmmaker says a failed project with Dr. Umar Johnson turned into legal threats, a six-figure demand and eventually a settlement. But, there's more...

item.title: Blueface Keeps Picking On King Harris Says He Looks Like His Girlfriend
item.description: King Harris got dragged into a wild back-and-forth after Blueface said his girlfriend looks like him, and things got really weird.

item.title: Kanye West & Bianca Censori Enjoy Low-Key Holiday Ballet Date
item.description: Kanye West and wife Bianca Censori attended a Christmas Eve performance of "The Nutcracker" ballet while trying to stay under the radar.

item.title: Jake Paul Broken Jaw KO Shatters Netflix’s Most-Watched Clip Record
item.description: Jake Paul suffered a shattered jaw after Anthony Joshua knocked him out on Netflix, capping a record-setting Miami fight watched by 33 million worldwide.

item.title: Nicki Minaj Deportation Petition Sparks Online Uproar
item.description: A viral petition calling for Nicki Minaj to be deported is gaining signatures online, even though it has no legal footing whatsoever.

item.title: Craig Mack Victim Of AIDS Conspiracy Says Ex-Wife, As Shocking Coincidence To Biggie’s Death Revealed
item.description: Craig Mack's ex-wife, Roxanne Hill, believes his AIDS diagnosis wasn't accidental and claims he warned others he was being targeted.

item.title: Clavicular Addresses Running Over Person In His Cybertruck During Christmas Eve Livestream
item.description: Clavicular was banned from Kick after his Cybertruck struck a man during a Christmas Eve Miami livestream, triggering a police probe and self-defense claims.

item.title: Tyrese’s Divorce Cost More Than Illseed’s Life
item.description: Tyrese says his divorce cost him nearly $2 million in legal fees and far more in public damage.

item.title: Tupac Estate Faces New Legal Pressure Over Royalty Claims From Producer’s Widow
item.description: A company founded by Tupac Shakur’s late mother asked a Los Angeles judge to dismiss a lawsuit alleging unpaid royalties tied to the rapper’s most iconic recordings.

item.title: 50 Cent Breaks Silence On Fabolous, Jim Jones, & Dave East
item.description: 50 Cent finally responded to the New York rap chatter with a calm statement instead of bars, leaving Hip-Hop debating whether patience or pressure will define what happens next.
